description: ParcelPal 1.2.5 remote-update edition. Foreground/open/pull-to-refresh run Taobao discovery like other platforms; last-sync updates even with 0 new orders; skips are stamped with version. Auth and keys unchanged.
name: 包裹助手（远程更新）

localizedDescriptions.zh: 1.2.5 远程更新版：打开 App、下拉刷新、全量同步时淘宝与其他平台一样参与；成功（含 0 个新订单）更新上次同步；被跳过时显示带版本号的原因。登录与密钥逻辑未改。
localizedDescriptions.en: 1.2.5 remote-update edition. Opening the app, pull-to-refresh, and full sync include Taobao like other platforms; last-sync updates even with 0 new orders; skipped runs show a version-stamped reason. Auth and keys unchanged.
